dorsal.rule: Confirmed only after axial/root thin-sheet topology, midline thickness, face-normal and repeated-series gates all pass.

ventral.rule: Confirmed only after axial/root thin-sheet topology, midline thickness, face-normal and repeated-series gates all pass.

peduncle.method: weighted body-vertex window; finlet midline points excluded from depth by lateral-support gate

interpretationBoundary: These are exact-source topology facts, not Thunnus albacares biological truth.
Low-face leading overlap candidates remain candidates until fixed-view visual acceptance.
Lateral keel z clusters are geometry candidates and are not yet accepted anatomical keels.
